title: rgeomex
text: English | Español rgeomex proporciona los polígonos de México del INEGI y del INE en varias resoluciones (estados, municipios, localidades, AGEB urbanos, manzanas y secciones electorales), y funciones para extraer los AGEB, manzanas y secciones de una localidad. rgeomex es parte del dengueverse. Su versión en Python es rgeomex-py; ambas usan los mismos archivos.

title: rgeomex
code: install.packages("rgeomex",                  repos = c("https://fdzul.r-universe.dev",                            "https://cloud.r-project.org"))  # o desde GitHub # install.packages("pak") pak::pkg_install("fdzul/rgeomex")

title: rgeomex
text: Desde la versión 0.2.0 las bases vienen dentro del paquete. Son archivos GeoParquet que se descargan la primera vez que se usan y se guardan en un caché local (rgeomex_cache_dir()), así la instalación es ligera y solo se descargan los estados que usas. Los nombres de las versiones anteriores siguen funcionando (por ejemplo rgeomex::AGEM_inegi19_mx).

title: rgeomex
text: Para trabajar sin conexión, o para compartir los archivos entre varios usuarios, define la variable de entorno RGEOMEX_DATA_DIR con una carpeta que tenga los archivos.
code: library(rgeomex)  # polígono de una localidad merida <- extract_locality(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida")  # AGEB, manzanas y secciones electorales de una localidad ageb      <- extract_ageb(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida") manzanas  <- extract_blocks(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida") secciones <- extract_sectores(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida")  # una base completa, o las filas de algunos estados rgeomex_datasets() yucatan <- rgeomex_load("AGEM_inegi19_mx", cve_edo = "31")

text: Los shapefiles originales son de instituciones oficiales (INEGI e INE).

title: Geographic Boundaries of Mexico from INEGI and INE
text: English | Español rgeomex provides geographic boundaries Mexico INEGI INE several resolutions (states, municipalities, localities, urban AGEB, blocks electoral sections), functions extract AGEB, blocks sections locality. rgeomex part dengueverse. Python version rgeomex-py; use files.

title: Geographic Boundaries of Mexico from INEGI and INE
code: install.packages("rgeomex",                  repos = c("https://fdzul.r-universe.dev",                            "https://cloud.r-project.org"))  # or from GitHub # install.packages("pak") pak::pkg_install("fdzul/rgeomex")

title: Geographic Boundaries of Mexico from INEGI and INE
text: Since version 0.2.0 datasets shipped inside package. GeoParquet files downloaded first time used kept local cache (rgeomex_cache_dir()), installation small states use downloaded. names previous versions still work (example rgeomex::AGEM_inegi19_mx).

title: Geographic Boundaries of Mexico from INEGI and INE
text: work offline, share files among several users, set environment variable RGEOMEX_DATA_DIR folder files.
code: library(rgeomex)  # boundary of a locality merida <- extract_locality(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida")  # AGEB, blocks and electoral sections of a locality ageb     <- extract_ageb(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida") blocks   <- extract_blocks(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida") sections <- extract_sectores(cve_edo = "31", locality = "Merida")  # a whole dataset, or the rows of some states rgeomex_datasets() yucatan <- rgeomex_load("AGEM_inegi19_mx", cve_edo = "31")

title: rgeomex 0.2.0
text: datasets longer shipped package (made 500 MB, large R-universe). GeoParquet files release data-v1 rgeomex-py, downloaded first time used, verified SHA-256 kept local cache. New functions rgeomex_load(), rgeomex_datasets(), rgeomex_cache_dir() rgeomex_clear_cache(). names previous versions (rgeomex::AGEM_inegi19_mx, rgeomex::blocks_ine20_mx_a, …) still work: download read files first use. text datasets UTF-8 (accents NOMGEO), hrl_mx CRS (EPSG:4326). extract_locality(), extract_ageb(), extract_blocks() extract_sectores() read state requested, faster. Fewer dependencies: mapview, ggplot2, lifecycle magrittr longer imported; nanoparquet jsonlite . Vignettes English Spanish, precomputed. Authors updated.
